story.text: 전주천을 따라 걷는 밤, 물소리만 낮게 울렸다. 평소와 달리 말이 없는 나를, 하늘이 힐끗 쳐다봤다.
story.reading: jeon-ju-cheon-eul tta-ra geot-neun bam, mul-so-ri-man nat-ge ul-lyeot-da. pyeong-so-wa dal-li mal-i eop-neun na-reul, ha-neul-i hil-kkeut chyeo-da-bwat-da.
story.en: Walking along Jeonjucheon stream at night, only the low sound of water echoed. Haneul glanced over at me, uncharacteristically quiet.

story.text: "무슨 고민 있어?" 그가 대뜸 물었다. 돌려 말하는 법이 없는 그다웠다.
story.reading: mu-seun go-min iss-eo? geu-ga dae-tteum mul-eot-da. dol-lyeo mal-ha-neun beob-i eop-neun geu-da-wot-da.
story.en: "You've got some kind of worry, don't you?" he asked, straight out. So like him, never one to beat around the bush.

story.text: 나는 잠시 망설이다, 요즘 마음 한구석을 짓누르던 이야기를 조금씩 털어놓기 시작했다. 잘하고 있는 건지, 이 길이 맞는 건지 모르겠다고.
story.reading: na-neun jam-si mang-seol-i-da, yo-jeum ma-eum han-gu-seog-eul jin-nu-reu-deon i-ya-gi-reul jo-geum-ssik teol-eo-noh-gi si-jak-haet-da. jal-ha-go it-neun geon-ji, i gil-i maj-neun geon-ji mo-reu-get-da-go.
story.en: I hesitated for a moment, then slowly began to open up about what had been weighing on a corner of my mind lately — that I didn't know if I was doing okay, if this was even the right path.

story.text: 하늘은 아무 말 없이 듣기만 했다. 다 듣고 나서야 짧게 말했다. "정답 몰라도 돼. 그냥 곁에 있을 테니까."
story.reading: ha-neul-eun a-mu mal eop-si deut-gi-man haet-da. da deut-go na-seo-ya jjalb-ge mal-haet-da. jeong-dap mol-la-do dwae. geu-nyang gyeot-e iss-eul te-ni-kka.
story.en: Haneul just listened, without a word. Only after I finished did he say, simply, "You don't have to know the answer. I'll just stay by your side."

story.text: 그는 손에 쥐고 있던 따뜻한 캔 커피를 아무 말 없이 내밀었다. "위로한다"는 말 한마디 없이도, 그 방식이 그를 닮아 있었다.
story.reading: geu-neun son-e jwi-go it-deon tta-tteut-han kaen keo-pi-reul a-mu mal eop-si nae-mil-eot-da. wi-ro-han-da-neun mal han-ma-di eop-si-do, geu bang-sig-i geu-reul dalm-a iss-eot-da.
story.en: Wordlessly, he held out the warm canned coffee he'd been holding. Without ever saying the words "I'm comforting you," this quiet gesture was exactly like him.

story.text: "진심으로 하는 말인데, 넌 지금도 충분히 잘하고 있어." 낮은 목소리가 물소리에 섞여 들렸다. 흔치 않은 그의 진심이 마음 깊이 박혔다.
story.reading: jin-sim-eu-ro ha-neun mal-in-de, neon ji-geum-do chung-bun-hi jal-ha-go iss-eo. naj-eun mok-so-ri-ga mul-so-ri-e seokk-yeo deul-lyeot-da. heun-chi anh-eun geu-ui jin-sim-i ma-eum gip-i bak-hyeot-da.
story.en: "I mean this sincerely — you're already doing plenty well right now." His low voice mixed in with the sound of the water. His rare sincerity sank deep into my heart.

story.text: 강바람이 선선하게 불었다. 말 몇 마디 나눴을 뿐인데, 마음 한구석이 훨씬 가벼워져 있었다. 이런 게 진짜 친구구나, 싶었다.
story.reading: gang-ba-ram-i seon-seon-ha-ge bul-eot-da. mal myeot ma-di na-nwoss-eul ppun-in-de, ma-eum han-gu-seog-i hwol-ssin ga-byeo-wo-jyeo iss-eot-da. i-reon ge jin-jja chin-gu-gu-na, sip-eot-da.
story.en: A cool breeze drifted off the river. We'd only exchanged a few words, but the weight on my mind felt so much lighter. This, I thought, is what a real friend is.

words.example_en: I have a lot on my mind lately.
I opened up about my worries to my friend.

words.example: 힘들 때 곁에 있어 줘서 고마워.
words.example_reading: him-deul ttae gyeot-e iss-eo jwo-seo go-ma-wo
words.example_en: Thanks for being by my side when things were hard.
